summary: Marketech International Corp. (MIC) specializes in marketing and technology integration support services for the semiconductor industry, offering advanced process equipment and customized manufacturing solutions. They also provide facility integration services, including clean room construction and wastewater treatment systems, catering to the needs of semiconductor and optoelectronics sectors.
